name: Alcia Elgrant
original_name: アルシア・エルグラント
source:
★The pure and lovely princess of the Magic Kingdom who admires Tsukasa★

She is the second princess of the Magic Kingdom, located within the vast forest area in the southern parts of the continent. She currently studies magic at the academy with her chaperone, the magical creature Siegfried. Perhaps because she comes from a closed off Magic Kingdom, she is a little naive, but her pure and cheerful personality makes her well-liked by everyone.

She has a good figure and quite large breasts.

She is also very enthusiastic about studying magic. She has a crush on Tsukasa, which he is somewhat aware of, having a crush of his own on Alcia.

[Translated from https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]
